title: Mitigating Cross-Lingual Cultural Inconsistencies in LLMs via Consensus-Driven Preference Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2605.12515v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multilingual large language models (MLLMs) often answer culturally ambiguous questions inconsistently across languages, even for a fixed user persona -- e.g., Shakespeare in English but Cervantes in Spanish for the same British user. To robustly quantify this Cross-lingual Cultural Inconsistency, we introduce Singleton Fleiss's $\kappa_S$, a metric mathematically resilient to hallucinations. For mitigation, we propose Cross-lingual Cultural Consistent Preference Optimisation (C-3PO), a consensus-driven alignment framework. C-3PO raises $\kappa_S$ by 0.07--0.10 over unaligned models, above every prompting and representation steering baseline averaged across personas, whilst largely preserving explicit user identities, cultural neutrality and intrinsic cultural knowledge; where it does not, a soft-consensus variant recovers most of the cost. Although trained only on multiple-choice questions, C-3PO also improves consistency in open-end

translated_title: 通过共识驱动的偏好优化缓解大语言模型中的跨语言文化不一致性
translated_abstract: 多语言大语言模型（MLLMs）在回答文化上具有歧义的问题时，常常在不同语言间给出不一致的答案，即使对于固定的用户人设也是如此——例如同一位英国用户，用英语提问会得到莎士比亚，而用西班牙语提问却得到塞万提斯。为了稳健地量化这种跨语言文化不一致性，我们引入了Singleton Fleiss's κ_S，这是一个在数学上对幻觉具有韧性的度量指标。作为缓解手段，我们提出了跨语言文化一致性偏好优化，这是一个共识驱动的对齐框架。C-3PO使κ_S相比未对齐模型提升了0.07–0.10，在跨人设平均的意义上超过了所有提示工程和表示引导的基线方法，同时大体上保留了明确的用户身份、文化中立性和内在文化知识；在未能保留之处，其软共识变体可以挽回大部分损失。尽管仅在多选题上进行训练，C-3PO还能提升开放式问题中的……（摘要截断于此）
tldr: 本文提出了对幻觉具有鲁棒性的跨语言文化不一致性度量指标κ_S，以及共识驱动的对齐框架C-3PO，能显著缓解多语言大模型在不同语言间回答文化歧义问题的不一致性，同时保留用户身份与文化知识。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Singleton Fleiss's κ_S, a hallucination-resilient metric for quantifying cross-lingual cultural inconsistency, and proposes C-3PO, a consensus-driven preference optimisation framework that substantially improves multilingual LLMs' cross-lingual cultural consistency while preserving user personas and cultural knowledge.
